theory_unit_id.description: Must reference an existing theory unit id

generated_by_ai.description: All exercises in MVP are AI-generated and must be verified against source

correct.description: Index for multiple-choice/true-false, array of indices for order-steps, mirror string for flashcards. Not used by code-completion (use blanks[].accepted_answers).

shuffle.description: Multiple-choice only. false keeps the authored order (use when the options or the prompt depend on position/letters).

explanation.description: Must reference the source theory unit

objective_id.description: Objetivo do PLAN.md do módulo (ex.: OBJ-1). Obrigatório quando o módulo tem pipeline_version: 1.

level.description: Nível cognitivo do exercício. Obrigatório quando o módulo tem pipeline_version: 1.

source_ref.description: Seção real da unidade teórica no formato '<theory_unit_id>#<section_id>'. Obrigatório quando o módulo tem pipeline_version: 1.

answer_check.description: Uma linha dizendo como a resposta foi conferida (ex.: 'Executado em Python 3.12; saída 42'). Obrigatório quando o módulo tem pipeline_version: 1.

code.description: Required for code-completion: fixed code with one or more '___' blanks (never edited by the student).

blanks.description: Required for code-completion: one entry per '___' in 'code', in the same order.

accepted_answers.description: Accepted answers for this blank. The first one is the reference answer shown on error. Compared after normalizing quotes and whitespace.

starter_code.description: Required for flashcards: back of the card (answer/definition).
